- Clarify burst mechanics and soft-throttle thresholds
- Invoice timing (we prefer quarterly invoicing if possible)

Evan — thanks for the context. We’ve pulled the usage history and sketched three
paths you can take. Attaching the usage export and a proposed SKU pack for the
uplift.

Summary options (monthly committed tokens):
- Option A (conservative): 300M — covers baseline + modest burst (no term change)
- Option B (recommended): 400M — covers forecast peak; includes burst pocket &
a 10% volume discount at 12-month term
- Option C (aggressive): 500M — for higher headroom; includes staged pricing and
priority provisioning (requires 24-month term)

Notes on controls:
- Soft-throttle at 120% of commit by default; we can increase to 140% with a
burst pocket that consumes overage credits first.
- Billing cadence: monthly by default; we can invoice quarterly under a PO
arrangement (finance OK with quarterly if committed amount is prepaid or
net-30 with a purchase order).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Quick 30-min call to confirm Option B vs C and clarify invoice cadence
2) We’ll send an updated order form + DocuSign link once you confirm
3) Ops will schedule an on-call with engineering to prepare a Q1 ramp day-of

Attachments: NimbleShop_Monthly_Usage_2026Q3.csv, NS_PROPOSED_COMMIT_SKU.pdf

Available slots next Tue/Wed 9–11am PT — does that work?

—Priyom

Subject: Re: Q1 renewal discussion + hosted commit uplift — next steps and order form

Dana / Evan — appreciate the clarity. Below is an actionable summary and the
DocuSign link for the Option B (400M monthly) order form. Please review and we
can finalize the PO.

Confirmed commercial terms (Option B):
- Committed monthly tokens: 400,000,000
- Committed rate: $12.50 per 1k tokens (billed on committed volume)
- Overage rate: $18.75 per 1k tokens (applies to any usage > commit, charged
monthly)
- Burst pocket: 80M tokens / month; measured as rolling 24-hour window; bursts
consume pocket first before overage applies
- Soft-throttle threshold: default at 120% of commit (480M); ops can raise to
140% during ramp with 7 days' notice and approval of a temporary burst top-up
- Term: 12 months (auto-renew); 5% quarterly-prepay discount if invoiced in
quarterly prepaid installments
- Invoice terms: Net 45 accepted for PO; finance contact Marissa will handle
final invoice cadence
- SLA: 99.5% availability for API endpoints; credits scale by impacted requests
during a certified breach (definitions in SOW).

DocuSign order form: https://www.docusign.com/links/abcdef1234567890
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/987654/record/HS-987654

Attachments: NimbleShop_PO_Draft.docx (editable PO for your procurement)

Next steps:
- Evan / Raj: confirm whether you want the 80M burst pocket included or if you
prefer to split into a 50M burst + 30M temporary ramp credit (ops usability)
- Dana / Marissa: confirm PO number and preferred invoicing cadence (quarterly
prepay vs Net 45)
- We will send final DocuSign within 24 hours of your confirmation and target
activation on 2027-01-01 to align with your Q1 launch.

If you want a short call to run through the runbook and latency mitigations,
ops can join Monday 11/15 10am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.
